details: Bitcoin is currently trading near $63,800, fluctuating around the $64,000 mark after touching a 24-hour low of $63,700. The broader crypto market capitalization fell by 1.1% to $2.28 trillion. This choppy price action is influenced by $225.18 million in net outflows from spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) on July 24, ending a seven-session inflow streak. The Crypto Fear & Greed Index is presently at 27, indicating "fear" in the market.
title: Bitcoin Dips to $64K Amid ETF Outflows & Macro Risk

details: The proposed U.S. "Clarity Act" legislation for digital assets is facing significant opposition from Democrats, who are demanding tougher language to prevent elected officials, including former President Trump, from profiting from the industry they regulate. Trump's reported $1.4 billion crypto windfall is highlighted as a primary obstacle to the bill's passage.
title: Trump's Crypto Holdings Create Ethics Hurdle for US Clarity Act

details: The attacker responsible for the $285 million breach of Drift Protocol on the Solana blockchain has reactivated after a three-month dormant period. The stolen funds are now being laundered through Tornado Cash, a privacy-focused Ethereum mixer, with deposits occurring in rapid batches of 100 ETH per transaction.
title: Drift Protocol Attacker Launders Stolen Funds via Tornado Cash
